audit_items.proof_trace: Although no code guard prevents the obligation owner from calling liquidate on their own obligation (no ctx.sender() != obligation.owner check), the economic math proves net wealth cannot increase. Net change = -repay * revenue_factor * (1 + incentive) ≤ 0: the protocol always retains revenue_factor of seized collateral (liquidate_ctokens L175-178 adds to cash_reserve), so the self-liquidator's combined wallet+obligation value strictly decreases by that fee. The property holds by economic design.
